change: Only await the existing File.copy Promise. No pointer, cleanup, provider, owner, identity, scope, package, lock or tsconfig changes.

baselineRed.product: Exact unchanged base native storage module
baselineRed.case: native storage waits for copy and pointer commit before retiring the previous image
baselineRed.reason: save settled while File.copy was still pending

portable.limits: JS network tripwire is not OS network isolation or native-device validation.

frontendNoEmit.dependencyMode: Previously installed lock-version-matched dependencies reused read-only; no dependency installation or patching.

ci.scope: Same repository, master target, stated branch, exact PR head
required: complete background-local file: exactly 18 passing cases and no skip
ci.static: YAML and three bash run bodies parsed; helper syntax checked; exact test arguments matched actual local run; TAP skip/wrong-count/duplicate-summary rejected.
ci.npmCi: NOT_RUN locally; CI installs unchanged lock with scripts disabled then applies existing repository patches offline.

retainedLimits: Cleanup failure can mask the original error.
SecureStore uncertain commit is not modelled by fail-before-write.
Cross-provider/session writes to the same durable scope are not serialized by this change.
Old-file cleanup is best-effort and can leave an app-private orphan.
Late accepted writes can finish in the original scope; logout/unmount do not cancel or undo persistence.
notRun: native binary or real Android/iOS device
complete mounted UI, browser, gestures or accessibility
process death, quota, lock state or OS backup
real model, API or production service
